name: Nemeton Tracker (Room, Turn & Durability HUD)
author: Nocturne
description: Koudelka exploration & battle companion HUD (100% Co-op Safe): live Room ID tracker, active battle turn banner, Level-Up callouts, and Weapon Durability at a Glance with configurable low-durability warnings.

settings.label: Weapon Durability HUD
settings.description: Show equipped weapon durability bars at a glance for Koudelka, Edward & James

settings.label: Low Durability Warning %
settings.description: Trigger a Gothic warning toast when a hero's weapon drops below this %

settings.label: Room ID Tracker Pill
settings.description: Display the current Nemeton Monastery room ID in the corner HUD

settings.label: Battle Turn Banner
settings.description: Show active party member turn & battle round count in the corner HUD

settings.label: Toggle Hotkey
settings.description: In-game key to show/hide Nemeton Tracker overlays
